title: Add schema version and numbered immutable migration runner
acceptance: Current schema is adopted non-destructively as a verified baseline; schema_migrations records version; rerun is no-op; local tests prove behavior.

title: Create representative old-database migration fixtures
acceptance: Fixtures cover representative prior schema eras and upgrade deterministically to current baseline.

title: Add migration integrity and orphan checks
acceptance: Pre/post checks detect corrupt DB, required-object gaps and actionable orphan conditions without destructive repair.

title: Create local verify_release command
acceptance: One repository-local command runs deterministic authoritative release checks without GitHub Actions.

title: Create isolated backup restore verification
acceptance: Backup restores to temporary DB, passes integrity/schema checks and application smoke checks without touching live DB.

title: Add full backup manifest and checksums
acceptance: Backup package/manifest identifies required state, versions, sizes and cryptographic checksums.

title: Add off-host backup copy hook and health record
acceptance: Server-local command can copy verified backup outside primary failure domain and record success/failure; no GitHub scheduler.

title: Core modularization, action policy and durable jobs
acceptance: Action registry, idempotency, generic durable jobs/outbox and first module extraction are implemented with local tests.

title: Stock position, movement ledger and reservation kernel
acceptance: Physical stock, reservation and ATP are explainable from durable records and proven under retry/concurrency.

title: Warehouse locations, receiving, putaway, scan and count
acceptance: Representative warehouse flows prove source/destination bin, scanned identity, quantity and controlled reconciliation.

title: Electronics part master, parameters, MPN and AVL
acceptance: Engineer/buyer can resolve controlled internal part from MPN/source and see parameters, AVL, stock and where-used context.

title: Revisioned EBOM/MBOM, ECN/ECO and controlled documents
acceptance: Released configuration is immutable, revisioned and sufficient to answer exact BOM/drawing/firmware applicability.

title: Work order and manufacturing execution spine
acceptance: One product can be built from released MBOM through controlled reserve/issue/return/scrap/output transactions.

title: Quality, lot/serial genealogy and RF test evidence
acceptance: Shipped serial can trace revision/build/required component lineage/firmware/test/calibration/customer with explicit legacy-untraced boundaries.

title: Procurement planning, MRP and subcontract
acceptance: Every MRP recommendation explains dated demand, qualified supply and policy; draft PO/WO requires controlled approval.

title: Omnichannel connector, ATP publication and reconciliation
acceptance: Connector retries/replays do not duplicate business objects; channel publication uses ATP and persistent mismatches become actionable reconciliation items.

title: CRM, quotation, samples, support and RMA
acceptance: Customer/order/serial/support/RMA lifecycle is navigable without manual file hunting and financial/physical return are separated.

title: Pricing safety, channel economics and manufacturing cost
acceptance: Margin/markup formulas are unambiguous and completed-order contribution is reproducible from immutable economic/cost events.

title: KPI lineage, executive reporting and product intelligence
acceptance: No management KPI appears without definition, lineage and reconciled drill-through.

title: Rules automation and exception routing
acceptance: Rules reduce manual checking with dedupe/audit/simulation and cannot auto-execute approval-required consequences.

title: Evidence-bound AI Copilot
acceptance: AI saves analysis time with evidence and permission scope while authoritative mutations remain deterministic and approved.

title: Conditional PostgreSQL/performance scale-up
acceptance: Starts only on measured entry criteria; migration preserves business invariants under identical backend contract tests.
